name_reason: Well-formed game global: data_fd2_ prefix + audio domain (it is an SFX bank handle; sibling 0x54117 and the loader fd2_load_figani_sfx_bank are both System=audio) + descriptor figani_sfx_bank_defender_buf_ptr which captures source (FIGANI stream), content (SFX handle bank), role qualifier (defender side, distinguishing it from the attacker-side 0x54117) and datatype (buf_ptr = heap pointer). 'defender' is a semantic role, not a Ghidra address residue. Name reflects datatype (pointer). No address suffix.
purpose: Heap pointer to the SFX handle bank loaded for the DEFENDER's FIGANI animation stream, used so the counter-attack pose in the full combat cinematic can play its own sound effects (defender-side counterpart of data_fd2_audio_figani_sfx_bank_buf_ptr @ 0x54117).
logic_summary: Sole owner/writer fd2_play_full_combat_cinematic. Written (0x28e5b: MOV [0x5411b],EAX) with the return of fd2_load_figani_sfx_bank(def_anim_figani) only on the non-scripted path (assignment block at 0x28e3e-0x28e58 is gated by data_fd2_battle_scripted_cinematic_mode_or_terrain_idx==0). Read/passed by value to fd2_execute_combat_hit_cinematic for the swapped-role counter cinematic on the normal-counter path (0x28ec4) AND the scripted forced-counter path (0x28efb); in scripted mode the bank was never assigned so it passes NULL, which the muted scripted-mode audio path ignores. Cleanup frees it when non-NULL (0x290fc, gated by != 0). fd2_load_figani_sfx_bank returns undefined4* = fd2_load_dat_resource(FDOTHER.DAT,...) buffer pointer or 0. Full 32-bit pointer, never indexed.
datatype: undefined4 (uint32) -- 32-bit heap pointer to the loaded FDOTHER.DAT SFX bank buffer
element_semantics: Single scalar pointer: NULL at rest (.bss zero-init), otherwise the malloc-backed FDOTHER.DAT SFX bank buffer returned by fd2_load_figani_sfx_bank for the defender FIGANI. Not an array; never indexed.
comment_original_issue: Source comment said the bank 'In the normal (non-scripted) path ... passes it by value to fd2_execute_combat_hit_cinematic for the swapped-role counter cinematic', which read as if the pass-by-value happened only on the normal path. Disassembly shows the value is also passed (read) on the scripted forced-counter path (0x28efb / src line 541), where the bank is NULL because the assignment is non-scripted-only. Refined to state the assignment is non-scripted-only while the pass-by-value happens on both the normal-counter and scripted forced-counter paths (NULL, ignored by muted scripted audio).
notes: Verified against live decompile + full disassembly of fd2_play_full_combat_cinematic (0x28a6c) and decompile of writer-callee fd2_load_figani_sfx_bank (0x2bc9a). Writer single (0x28e5b); reads at 0x28ec4/0x28efb/0x290f3/0x290fc all inside the same function. .bss (all-zero at rest), .object2 segment, undefined4/4 bytes. is_const=false (game writer present). Ghidra plate already accurate and consistent with refined src comment -> left unchanged.
